cards.name: Diregraf Ghoul
cards.oracle_text: This creature enters tapped.

research.note: An inexpensive Zombie body that can trigger white mummy payoffs or receive tribal bonuses from any partner.
research.caution: Enters tapped, so it cannot immediately block.

cards.name: Shambling Ghast
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature dies, choose one —
• Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
• Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

research.note: A cheap Zombie with a useful death trigger; its Treasure option can help cast the other packet's spells.
research.caution: Uses a modal death trigger and may require a Treasure token. Its -1/-1 effect lasts only for the turn.

cards.name: Festering Mummy
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.

research.note: A small mummy that can weaken a creature when it dies, supporting sacrifice effects and combat across packets.
research.caution: Uses a -1/-1 counter, requiring distinction from temporary power reductions and +1/+1 counters.

cards.name: Lazotep Reaver
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, amass Zombies 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control. It's also a Zombie. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature token first.)

research.note: Adds a Zombie body and amass support, providing material for attacks, entry triggers, or sacrifice.
research.caution: Amass grows an existing Army when possible; it does not simply make a fresh token every time.

cards.name: Undead Augur
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another Zombie you control dies, you draw a card and lose 1 life.

research.note: Turns deaths of Zombies from any of the three packets into cards.
research.caution: The card draw and life loss are mandatory; several Zombies dying together can cost substantial life.
research.manaNote: Costs BB, which is more demanding in a two-color combined deck.

cards.name: Lord of the Accursed
cards.oracle_text:
Other Zombies you control get +1/+1.
{1}{B}, {T}: All Zombies gain menace until end of turn.

research.note: Boosts other Zombies regardless of color and can give the horde menace to finish combat stalls.
research.caution: Its activated ability grants menace to all Zombies, including any opposing Zombies; the static bonus only affects your other Zombies.

cards.name: Ghoulraiser
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return a Zombie card at random from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: A Zombie that recovers another Zombie card, with candidates supplied by any partner packet.
research.caution: The returned card is selected at random, not chosen; an empty graveyard provides no value.

cards.name: Gravedigger
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: A simple Zombie body that can return any creature card from your graveyard to hand, including non-Zombie support creatures.
research.caution: Four mana and a populated graveyard are needed for its full value.

cards.name: Undead Butler
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, mill three cards. (Put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)
When this creature dies, you may exile it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: Seeds the graveyard and later recovers a creature, supporting blue self-mill and black recovery plans.
research.caution: Returning a creature requires exiling the Butler when it dies, so that copy cannot itself be reused afterward.

cards.name: Crow of Dark Tidings
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters or dies, mill two cards. (Put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)

research.note: A flying Zombie that mills on both entering and dying; combines an attacker with fuel for recursion.
research.caution: Repeated milling can consume a forty-card deck quickly; it is not card draw.

cards.name: Liliana's Elite
cards.oracle_text: This creature gets +1/+1 for each creature card in your graveyard.

research.note: Rewards the self-mill and creature trading available in blue and black, while remaining a Zombie for white triggers.
research.caution: Needs creature cards in the graveyard and shrinks when those cards are recovered or exiled.

cards.name: Ghoulcaller's Chant
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return two target Zombie cards from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: One cheap spell can recover two Zombies of any color, rewarding the shared theme across packets.
research.caution: Returns cards to hand, not the battlefield; its stronger mode needs two Zombie targets.

cards.name: Cemetery Recruitment
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.

research.note: Recovers a creature and draws an extra card if it is a Zombie, pairing naturally with either other Zombie packet.
research.caution: Needs a creature target in the graveyard; non-Zombie support creatures do not provide the bonus card.

cards.name: Rise from the Grave
cards.oracle_text: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.

research.note: Necromancy that can revive a creature from either graveyard and make it an additional black Zombie.
research.caution: Can steal the opponent's largest creature; the new color/type additions need to remain visible.

cards.name: Liliana's Mastery
cards.oracle_text:
Zombies you control get +1/+1.
When this enchantment enters, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

research.note: Creates two Zombies and increases the size of every Zombie you control, supporting all three colors.
research.caution: A substantial board swing that may dominate a low-power packet environment.

cards.name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, create X 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens, where X is half the number of Zombies you control, rounded down.

research.note: Grows a Zombie board over successive upkeeps using Zombies from either packet.
research.caution: Does nothing without at least two Zombies and can snowball rapidly if left unanswered.

cards.name: Dark Salvation
cards.oracle_text: Target player creates X 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens, then up to one target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each Zombie that player controls.

research.note: Combines Zombie creation with removal that scales with the selected player's Zombie count.
research.caution: Two X symbols make the total cost 2X plus B; the removal counts existing Zombies too.

cards.name: Dead Weight
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets -2/-2.

research.note: Cheap death-themed removal that gives the creature-heavy Zombie plan an early way to manage opposing threats.
research.caution: Generic support rather than a Zombie payoff; larger creatures can survive the -2/-2 Aura.

cards.name: Unearth
cards.oracle_text:
Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

research.note: Returns a cheap creature directly to the battlefield and can be cycled when recursion is not useful.
research.caution: Only recovers creatures with mana value three or less; does not recover the packet's larger finishers.

cards.name: Call of the Death-Dweller
cards.oracle_text: Return up to two target creature cards with total mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a deathtouch counter on either of them. Then put a menace counter on either of them.

research.note: Can recover two small creatures from either packet and enhance them with keyword counters.
research.caution: Returned creatures must total mana value three or less; deathtouch and menace counters require tracking.

cards.name: Screeching Skaab
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, mill two cards.

research.note: An early stitched Zombie that fuels recursion and graveyard payoffs from either packet.
research.caution: Mills cards without replacing them in hand; the partner should provide a reason to use the graveyard.

cards.name: Armored Skaab
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, mill four cards.

research.note: A defensive stitched creature that puts four cards into the graveyard to enable recovery and other graveyard plans.
research.caution: Four-card self-mill is substantial in a forty-card deck.

cards.name: Organ Hoarder
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

research.note: Provides a Zombie body and selects a card for hand while putting the other examined cards in the graveyard.
research.caution: Four mana; it supplies selection and graveyard fuel rather than a particularly fast start.

cards.name: Stitched Mangler
cards.oracle_text:
This creature enters tapped.
When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.

research.note: A stitched Zombie that temporarily clears an opposing blocker and can support attacks from either packet.
research.caution: Enters tapped and only delays the target's next untap rather than removing it permanently.

cards.name: Stitchwing Skaab
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
{1}{U}, Discard two cards: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

research.note: A flying stitched Zombie with its own graveyard return ability; discard can seed other recovery effects.
research.caution: Returning it costs two discarded cards and brings it back tapped.

cards.name: Advanced Stitchwing
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
{2}{U}, Discard two cards: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

research.note: A larger flying stitched Zombie with repeatable graveyard return, independent of black support.
research.caution: Returning it costs two discarded cards and puts it onto the battlefield tapped.
research.manaNote: Its initial spell costs 3UU; the return ability costs 2U.

cards.name: Hordewing Skaab
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Other Zombies you control have flying.
Whenever one or more Zombies you control deal combat damage to one or more of your opponents, you may draw cards equal to the number of opponents dealt damage this way. If you do, discard that many cards.

research.note: Gives other Zombies flying and turns their combat damage into optional draw-and-discard, tying all packet colors together.
research.caution: Team-wide flying may overwhelm a Plant packet with insufficient reach or removal.

cards.name: Cleaver Skaab
cards.oracle_text: {3}, {T}, Sacrifice another Zombie: Create two tokens that are copies of the sacrificed creature.

research.note: Replaces another Zombie with two token copies, reusing entry triggers and multiplying useful bodies from either partner.
research.caution: Needs another Zombie and time to activate; copied tokens can create strong engines and substantial tracking.

cards.name: Stitched Assistant
cards.oracle_text:
Exploit (When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature.)
When this creature exploits a creature, scry 1, then draw a card. (To scry 1, look at the top card of your library, then you may put that card on the bottom.)

research.note: Exploit converts a creature into scry and a card, using expendable Zombies or death triggers from either packet.
research.caution: The exploit choice can sacrifice the Assistant itself; players must evaluate the lost body.

cards.name: Repository Skaab
cards.oracle_text:
Exploit (When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature.)
When this creature exploits a creature, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: Exploit can recover an instant or sorcery of either color, supporting necromancy or white combat spells.
research.caution: Needs both a useful spell in the graveyard and a creature to exploit for the full effect.

cards.name: Selhoff Entomber
cards.oracle_text: {T}, Discard a creature card: Draw a card.

research.note: A stitched Zombie that trades creature cards in hand for fresh draws and graveyard material.
research.caution: Only creature cards can pay its discard cost; its tap ability cannot be used immediately without haste.

cards.name: Geralf, Visionary Stitcher
cards.oracle_text:
Zombies you control have flying.
{U}, {T}, Sacrifice another nontoken creature: Create an X/X blue Zombie creature token, where X is the sacrificed creature's toughness.

research.note: A thematic mad-scientist support creature that gives Zombies flying and turns other creatures into Zombie tokens.
research.caution: Geralf is a Human Wizard, not a Zombie. Sacrifices must be other nontoken creatures, and the token's size uses toughness. Team-wide flying can be powerful.

cards.name: Startle
cards.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -2/-0 until end of turn. Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed. (It can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat.)
Draw a card.

research.note: A defensive combat trick that replaces itself and leaves a decayed Zombie token for attacks or sacrifice.
research.caution: Decayed tokens cannot block and are sacrificed at end of combat after attacking.

cards.name: Flip the Switch
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {4}. Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed. (It can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat.)

research.note: Counters an opposing spell unless its controller pays and adds a decayed Zombie to the table.
research.caution: Requires leaving mana open; the opponent may pay to prevent the counter. The token has decayed.

cards.name: Rise from the Tides
cards.oracle_text: Create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.

research.note: A necromantic blue finisher that converts spent or milled instants and sorceries from both packets into Zombies.
research.caution: Six mana; needs a sufficient spell count and creates the tokens tapped.

cards.name: Rooftop Storm
cards.oracle_text: You may pay {0} rather than pay the mana cost for Zombie creature spells you cast.

research.note: An iconic stitched-Zombie enchantment that removes the mana payment for casting Zombie creature spells of either packet color.
research.caution: Six-mana engine with no immediate body; free Zombie casting can enable disproportionate recursion combinations.

cards.name: Compelling Deterrence
cards.oracle_text: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Then that player discards a card if you control a Zombie.

research.note: Bounces a nonland permanent and adds discard when you control a Zombie, making the theme mechanically relevant.
research.caution: Can target your own permanent too; if you control a Zombie, its controller must discard a card.

cards.name: Necroduality
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a nontoken Zombie you control enters, create a token that's a copy of that creature.

research.note: Copies nontoken Zombies entering under your control, extending white entry payoffs and black recursion.
research.caution: A powerful duplication engine; copying a legendary Zombie invokes the legend rule and can create unintended complexity.

cards.name: Binding Mummy
cards.oracle_text: Whenever another Zombie you control enters, you may tap target artifact or creature.

research.note: Each additional Zombie can tap an artifact or creature, so black or blue creatures naturally help clear blockers.
research.caution: Only triggers for another Zombie entering under your control, not the Mummy itself.

cards.name: Disposal Mummy
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.

research.note: A mummy body with a straightforward effect that removes a card from the opponent's graveyard.
research.caution: Its graveyard effect may be low-impact against a Plant packet without recursion.

research.note: A simple mummy body that benefits from general Zombie entry triggers and tribal boosts without adding rules overhead.
research.caution: Four-mana vanilla creature; assess whether it meaningfully contributes to the packet's curve.

cards.name: Fan Bearer
cards.oracle_text: {2}, {T}: Tap target creature.

research.note: A one-mana mummy that can tap blockers or attackers later, useful with either partner color.
research.caution: The ability costs two mana and tapping the Bearer; it requires timing before attackers are declared to prevent an attack.

cards.name: God-Eternal Oketra
cards.oracle_text:
Double strike
Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 4/4 black Zombie Warrior creature token with vigilance.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.

research.note: A Zombie deity that rewards creature spells from either packet with vigilant Zombie tokens.
research.caution: Likely far above the desired starting power level; repeated 4/4 tokens and its library-return ability demand careful testing.

cards.name: Mummy Paramount
cards.oracle_text: Whenever another Zombie you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

research.note: Another Zombie entering temporarily grows this mummy, making all partner-color Zombies useful follow-up plays.
research.caution: The bonus ends with the turn and does not use counters.

cards.name: Pride of the Road
cards.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Start your engines! (If you have no speed, it starts at 1. It increases once on each of your turns when an opponent loses life. Max speed is 4.)
Max speed — At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature or Vehicle you control gains double strike until end of turn.

research.note: A vigilant mummy that can eventually grant double strike to a creature from either packet.
research.caution: Introduces the speed subsystem and needs damage across turns before its payoff; optional complexity candidate.

cards.name: Priest of the Crossing
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
At the beginning of each end step, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.

research.note: A flying Zombie cleric that rewards creature deaths by placing counters across your surviving board.
research.caution: The bonus can become enormous after multiple deaths, especially with sacrifice outlets; counts creatures that died under your control.

cards.name: Sparring Mummy
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, untap target creature.

research.note: A mummy that untaps a creature on entry, enabling a blocker or reusing a tap ability from either packet.
research.caution: Untapping a newly cast creature does not remove summoning sickness.

research.note: A simple three-mana mummy that supplies a reliable body for shared Zombie payoffs.
research.caution: Vanilla creature; offers little beyond stats without support.

cards.name: Wizened Mentor
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a permanent that isn't a mana ability, you create a 1/1 white Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.

research.note: A mummy cleric that produces Zombie tokens when opponents activate qualifying permanent abilities.
research.caution: Depends on the opposing packet containing relevant activated abilities; triggers only once each turn and excludes mana abilities.

cards.name: In Oketra's Name
cards.oracle_text: Zombies you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.

research.note: An Amonkhet-themed team pump with a larger bonus for Zombies, applying across all partner colors.
research.caution: Its bonus is temporary; non-Zombie support creatures receive the smaller bonus.

cards.name: Time to Reflect
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature that blocked or was blocked by a Zombie this turn.

research.note: Efficient mummy-themed removal tied directly to a Zombie blocking or being blocked.
research.caution: The target must have blocked or been blocked by a Zombie earlier in the current turn; it cannot answer an unrelated creature.

cards.name: Djeru's Resolve
cards.oracle_text:
Untap target creature. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

research.note: An Amonkhet support trick that untaps and shields a creature, with cycling when the effect is not needed.
research.caution: Provides no Zombie-specific bonus; protects from damage for the turn rather than from all removal.

cards.name: Unconventional Tactics
cards.oracle_text:
Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains flying until end of turn.
Whenever a Zombie you control enters, you may pay {W}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: Gives a creature a temporary size boost and flying, then can return to hand when another Zombie enters.
research.caution: The recovery trigger requires a white mana payment, and the spell is a sorcery.
